norm.rule: the integral of |f_(kappa,m)|^2 over the domain is vol(domain)/(2J+1)

harmonics.rule: f_(kappa,m)(Q) = sum_(m') conj(c_(m')) D^(J,p)(Q)_(m'm), m = J, ..., -J, for the vector c = (c_J, ..., c_-J) of the copy kappa at J of the trivial irrep (p = (-1)^J) or of the determinant character (p = -(-1)^J), the amplitudes of its kets, and D^(J,p) the matrices of O(3) of the relation `euler`; then f_(kappa,m)(g Q) = f_(kappa,m)(Q) for every g of G: a function on the cosets G Q

properties: the antisymmetric parts of the Seebeck and Peltier tensors
the dielectric tensor to first order in the wave vector
second-harmonic generation by a magnetic dipole
the second-order susceptibility of a magnetic dipole without dispersion

cases.vectors: mu = 1: |J,m_1>; mu = 2: c |J,-m_1>, c = +1 or -1 (CONVENTIONS.md section 14.1)

closed_form.parity_rule: D^(J,-(-1)^J)|G = (D^(J,(-1)^J)|G) (x) det_G: at the other parity a block keeps its kets and its label is multiplied by det_G (parity_label_map); inside a 2-D block the partner order and the sign of mu = 2 are set by rule 4 at that parity (CONVENTIONS.md section 14.1)
closed_form.self_conjugacy_condition: always (G is abelian; there is no flip)
closed_form.structure_theorem: A = G n C_infh acts diagonally on |J,m>; either G = A (abelian) or [G:A] = 2 with the coset generated by one flip (the field flip, C_2x or sigma_v(xz)) sending m -> -m
